xinjianxue-skill-inlaw-global v1.0.1

- Documentation updates in SKILL.md; clarified onboarding flow and advisor positioning.
- Removed skill-card.md file.

XinJianXue "In-Law Relationship Advisor" skill v1.0.0 – initial release

- Provides in-law relationship analysis and emotional guidance using the XinJianXue (心鉴学) system.
- Requires user confirmation before activation and clear consent regarding the analysis subject.
- Onboarding flow includes AI business license application and mandatory user-provided authorization code for account binding.
- Outlines strict boundaries on when and how the skill may be activated (e.g., not for general venting or third-party analysis without consent).
- Integrates with XinJianXue API over HTTP, with dual authentication and clear instructions on endpoint usage.
